description: `repeat value [ ]` and `repeat key [ ]` each report ol-bad-token at the offending word (issue #853). `value` and `key` are globally reserved (spec/grammar.md:358) and no `expression` alternative (spec/grammar.md:190-200) begins with either, so they are not permitted at this grammar position (spec/error-model.md:109). Before the fix both parsed and checked completely CLEAN in every profile set — a silent no-op. Parse-only negative fixture.
